attribution.note: Marcus directly states and endorses the capability assessment.

semantics.note: The normalisation preserves the present-tense assessment of all three capabilities and its scientific context.

contract.note: Dependable command in demanding scientific work is a fair plain reading. The contract reasonably distinguishes occasional successes from firm capability and assesses each component separately.

evidence.note: The contemporaneous benchmark supports logical-reasoning limitations in tested models, but does not cover the full range of AI systems or establish the required scientific capability threshold.

The contemporaneous benchmark supports limitations in formal counterfactual reasoning among tested models. Reported improvements and limited coverage prevent a general conclusion about all causal reasoning.

Peer-reviewed results demonstrate original mathematical discoveries with an evaluator-assisted system. They qualify a blanket denial of originality but do not establish dependable command under the contract.

Google reports novel proposals and laboratory validation with expert guidance. This company disclosure supplies relevant counterevidence on originality, without independently establishing dependable capability.

reviews.rationale: The benchmarks support narrower logic and causal-reasoning limitations. FunSearch and Google's co-scientist provide evidence of original results, but do not settle dependable originality. The packet neither establishes limitations across all three components at the specified scientific level nor establishes dependable command of any one component.
